title: Collateral Protection Premium Rate Table by Number of Units — Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
**Rate rule.** The annual percentage for an Equipment & Vehicle Loans collateral protection premium depends on how many units still secure the loan: 5.5 for three or more units, 6.0 for two units, and the product's collateral protection annual percentage for a single unit.

| Units still securing the loan on the placement date | Annual percentage |
|---|---|
| three or more | 5.5 |
| two | 6.0 |
| one | the product's collateral protection annual percentage |

**Counting the units.** The units still securing the loan are the units pledged to it less the units since released, as the loan's collateral record shows on the placement date; a unit pledged and later released, for instance on sale or on a substitution, no longer counts.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**
- A loan that was secured by four units, one of them since released on sale, has three units still securing it: 5.5.
- A loan with two units pledged and none released: 6.0.
- A loan with a single unit still pledged on a Truck & Trailer Loan: the product's own figure, 6.5.
